name: Add sprintTaskId drag support to tabs
description:
- User requested that chat-backed tabs register their chat id as `sprintTaskId` on drag, readable via `event.dataTransfer.getData('sprintTaskId')`.
- I recommended making the tab conditionally `draggable="true"` only when a `chat` exists, keeping plain app/tool tabs non-draggable.
- Added `@dragstart="onDragStart"` and a `cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing` affordance to the tab root element.
- The `onDragStart` method guards on `this.chat`, then calls `event.dataTransfer.setData('sprintTaskId', this.chat.id)` with `effectAllowed = 'move'`.
- Provided full Tab.vue, a specs table, anti-patterns, accessibility notes, and step-by-step implementation, plus the drop-side read instruction.

messages.content:
If the tab has a chat and starts dragging we'll register the chat id as "sprintTaskId".
event.dataTransfer.getData('sprintTaskId')
